events.event: Polres Bogor announced it foiled the recruitment of 22 Indonesian men for Russian mercenary service and arrested two recruiters who allegedly already sent about 200 people via Thailand.
events.key_numbers: 22 WNI stopped · 2 suspects (FIK 37, STH 38) · offer: USD 10,000 signing bonus + USD 3,000/month · ~200 allegedly already sent (under verification) · USD 600 commission per recruit · max 15 years (UU 21/2007, UU 18/2017) · route Bogor-Thailand-Russia
events.why_it_matters: Shows how job-seekers are lured with big salaries into a foreign war; a new, bigger scale (200 sent) than earlier cases.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia terbaru 21 Nov; detik/Okezone/Liputan6 coverage

events.event: Jakarta Governor Pramono Anung's UMP 2027 of about Rp6.1 million dominated detik's most-read list on 21 Nov, with union leader Said Iqbal arguing Jakarta's wage trails Bekasi's.
events.key_numbers: UMP DKI 2027 Rp6,136,941 · +Rp407,065 (+7.1%) · detik terpopuler #2 · Central Java UMP 2027 Rp2.65 million (+14.1%, CNBC 21 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: Directly sets what millions of Jakarta workers earn in 2027; regional comparisons (Bekasi, Jateng) fuel debate.

events.event: BMKG recorded an M7.2 earthquake at sea about 43 km northwest of Maluku Barat Daya at 16:42 WIB; no tsunami, no official damage reports yet.
events.key_numbers: M7.2 · depth 125 km · 7.88S 127.51E · 16:42:11 WIB Sat 21 Nov · MMI IV in Tiakur, Romang, Babar · no tsunami
events.why_it_matters: Second M7+ Banda Sea quake in a week (E0907 was M7.1 on 17 Nov); people ask about tsunami risk.

events.event: Fadli Zon, questioned by police as a victim, said his phone was wiretapped from 2021 to 2026 by ex-Kapolri Listyo Sigit's circle; four generals are named suspects.
events.key_numbers: Tapped 2021-2026 (about 5 years) · questioned twice · 4 active generals suspects (Listyo Sigit, Ahrie Sonta, Eko Hadi Santoso, Slamet Uliandi) · 3 detained at Mako Brimob
events.why_it_matters: The wiretapping scandal widens from the President to other senior figures, with the ethics hearing due this week.
events.spreading_evidence: detik latest (12 min ago, 21 Nov); CNN Indonesia

events.event: Bengkulu police chief Irjen Yudhi Sulistianto Wahid bowed in prostration before dozens of Cipayung Plus students, apologising for officers' conduct during demonstrations; the clip went viral.
events.key_numbers: Meeting 19 Nov · dozens of students · clip viral by 21 Nov · related: 3 DIY police placed in Patsus over 10 Nov Yogyakarta demo riot
events.why_it_matters: Rare public apology by a senior police officer amid a police-credibility crisis.
events.spreading_evidence: CNN Indonesia terbaru #1 (21 Nov) 'Momen Viral'; reported viral on social media

events.event: The ICJ ruled that Myanmar is responsible for genocide against the Rohingya; China criticised the ruling and Indonesia's DPR Commission I welcomed it and urged ASEAN to act.
events.key_numbers: detik terpopuler #1 on 21 Nov · DPR Komisi I backs ruling
events.why_it_matters: Historic ruling against an ASEAN neighbour; relevant to Indonesia's stance and Rohingya refugees in Aceh. (Global area may also cover.)

events.event: BNPB's operations summary listed floods, karhutla and extreme weather across 9 provinces on 20-21 Nov, including floods in 5 subdistricts of Singkawang.
events.key_numbers: 9 provinces (Sumut, Riau, Sumsel, Banten, Jabar, Jatim, Kalbar, Sulsel, Sulteng) · Singkawang flood 20 Nov, 5 subdistricts, 13 kelurahan · Kemenhut 307 hotspots on 21 Nov, most in Papua Selatan
events.why_it_matters: Floods and fires at once: the El Nino-hit dry spell and early rainy season both hit.

events.event: detik's latest feed carried a thin orangutan being released back to forest after suspected karhutla exposure in Central Kalimantan, a fire in a Baduy village hitting 34 families, and a Ujung Kulon statement on a rhino transport cage.
events.key_numbers: Baduy fire: 34 families · orangutan release (Kalteng karhutla)
events.why_it_matters: Human-interest follow-ons to the haze and Ujung Kulon rhino storylines.
